en.abdullah-al-shahin: (17) Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sa’eed narrated from Ali bin al-Hasan from his father from Rifa’a bin Musa that Abdullah bin Atta’ had said:

“I asked Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as): “When al-Qa’im (as) rises, what will he do to people?” He said: “He will annul all that has been established before him as the Prophet (S) has done and he will resume Islam anew.”
